name: Instagram Unfollow Detector
description: Détecte les comptes Instagram qui ne te suivent pas en retour.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https://*.cdninstagram.com https://*.fbcdn.net; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://www.instagram.com; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
